user_question: Why does ADC always read 4095 (max) even with input voltage at 0V?
expected_root_cause: ADC calibration not initialized - esp_adc_cal_characterize() not called, and GPIO may not be configured as analog
expected_fix: Call esp_adc_cal_characterize() and ensure GPIO is configured for ADC function; check for pin conflicts

expected_code_issues.suggestion: Add esp_adc_cal_characterize() and verify pin is not used by other peripheral

expected_serial_log_events.likely_cause: Missing ADC calibration or pin mux conflict
expected_serial_log_events.suggested_action: Initialize ADC calibration; verify pin is not shared with digital function

expected_follow_up_required: Check ESP32 Technical Reference Manual for ADC calibration procedure
